name: movie_etaori_lpqi_orbit_node90
label: Movie: eta Ori Aa through one 8-day orbit on the LPQI-Pathfinder, eight consecutive nights, line of nodes rotated by 90 deg (H-alpha, MPD)
notes: Same plan as movie_etaori_lpqi_orbit with the orbit's line of nodes at PA 90 (East-West) instead of 0: the node angle of the spectroscopic pair is unknown, and the fringe swept by the NOT-TNG track depends on the angle between the separation vector and the projected baseline.
The eclipse nights, the third light and the per-night fit are as in the PA 0 campaign; compare the two movies' fringe amplitudes and the final sigma(a)/a.
